Inkstone (d33mobile)

Inkstone Chinese flashcard app with Anki SM-2 scheduling. Private build by d33mobile.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://d33mobile.github.io/inkstone/fdroid/repo
